organization.name: Sting
organization.type: Closed-Loop Payment System & On-Demand Alcohol Delivery App
organization.description: Sting is a software-led transaction rail for Southern Africa's unbanked consumers, built around Sting Wallet, a closed-loop payment system. It enters the market through social group purchasing for on-demand alcohol delivery — customers order from their phone and an independent delivery runner brings the order to their door, the way you would use Uber Eats or Mr D Food, but built specifically around alcohol, drinks, and a wallet you can share with friends.
audience: Adults 18 and older in South Africa who want alcohol, cold drinks, mixers, or ice delivered on demand, including unbanked and cash-reliant consumers

founder.name: Craig Gazimbi
founder.jobTitle: Co-Founder and Chief Product & Technology Officer
founder.description: Craig Gazimbi is the Co-Founder and Chief Product & Technology Officer at Sting. He built Sting's entire technical infrastructure end to end — the customer mobile app, the backend, and sting.delivery.

what_sting_is.description: Both a closed-loop payment system and an on-demand alcohol delivery app, by design — not a general food-delivery app, and not just a delivery app.
what_sting_is.payment_system: Sting Wallet is a closed-loop payment system: money loaded in by card or EFT can only be spent on Sting orders, never withdrawn or sent for any other purpose.
what_sting_is.delivery_wedge: Alcohol, cold drink, mixer, and ice delivery is the everyday, high-frequency consumer need that gives Sting's audience a reason to load money into Sting Wallet in the first place.
what_sting_is.differentiator: Unlike Uber Eats or Mr D Food, Sting is purpose-built around alcohol and a shared wallet: age and identity verification are core to the ordering flow, and a group of customers can pool a Sting Wallet balance in one shared cart and split the cost of an order.

how_it_works.description: A customer signs up, confirms they are 18 or older, sets a delivery address, optionally verifies a South African ID, tops up Sting Wallet, browses a partner store, and checks out by card or Sting Wallet. An independent delivery runner collects and delivers the order, checking a physical identification document in person regardless of the online step.
steps: Sign up and confirm you are 18+
Optional, skippable South African ID verification
Top up Sting Wallet by card or EFT (or pay by card directly)
Browse a partner store and build a cart, alone or shared with friends
Independent runner delivers, checking ID in person

market_context.description: Sting's stated thesis for why it is building in Southern Africa now.
market_context.the_gap: East and West Africa have built large mobile-money networks moving an estimated $1.3 trillion outside traditional bank rails, but Southern Africa has lagged behind, with only an estimated 5 million active digital wallets.
market_context.the_consumer: Much of Southern Africa's informal economy, including township retail, still runs on physical cash, leaving it largely outside card-reliant e-commerce.
market_context.the_approach: Sting gives this cash-heavy population an immediate, compelling reason to move money into a digital wallet — on-demand alcohol delivery — rather than asking people to adopt a wallet for its own sake.

sting_wallet.description: A closed-loop in-app payment balance. Customers load money in by card or EFT and spend it only on Sting orders — paying for their own order or contributing their balance toward a shared order with friends in a shared cart.
closed_loop_facts: No cash-out or withdrawal path exists.
No general-purpose money transfer out of Sting to anyone outside the platform.
Balances move only between a customer's own orders and shared carts they take part in.

identity_verification.description: Age self-certification is required for every customer. A South African ID check is offered during sign-up purely to speed up verification and can always be skipped. Sting never stores the raw ID number submitted — only a one-way cryptographic hash of it, used to confirm validity and detect duplicate accounts.
identity_verification.always_required: In-person identification check by the delivery runner at handover.
identity_verification.always_optional: Online South African ID verification during sign-up.

how_to_engage.entry_point: Sign up and order at sting.delivery

related_platform.name: Sting Runner
related_platform.relationship: The separate application and onboarding process for people who deliver Sting orders. Shares Sting's underlying account system but has its own content, terms, and audience — not described by this manifest.
